full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D06A.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRUCTURAL READING AID:
1. All FOUR specimens compared. Choose one coherent THX/CCZ-style whole construction: tall LEFT and RIGHT outer gateway sides, with separate upper left/right leaf panels; center gap remains fully open.
2. Each upper leaf has EXACTLY TWO stacked closed counters, FOUR closed fields total. Inner upright of each leaf projects a short way ABOVE its curved upper horizontal and bends outward to its lower horizontal; outer upright continues down as its long gateway side. Middle horizontal inside each leaf divides its two counters.
3. Left and right leaf panels mirror each other across a clear upper center gap. Never join the two projecting inner uprights or cap that center gap.
4. Inside lower gateway sits a separate three-horizontal/one-vertical motif: all three bars joined by one center vertical that starts ON its upper bar, crosses middle, ends ON baseline. Baseline is longest, upper/middle shorter, with middle-to-baseline gap larger than upper-to-middle.
5. Keep generous gaps between the inner lower motif and both long side legs, and a gap between it and upper leaves. Outer gateway stays OPEN across bottom; no connections from lower motif to sides or upper leaves.
All four variants inform identity, but choose the complete THX/CCZ attested FOUR-counter upper-leaf construction consistently; do not mix its closed upper leaves with QJZ/DYC open upper tips. Retain TWO long outside legs and the independent inner lower three-bar stem. Truly parallel-sided geometric stroke tubes, no brush silhouettes.
